title: Filter<T> generic with untagged serde + Operator-first variant order — correct and load-bearing
description: The Filter<T> type in jmap-types::query uses #[serde(untagged)] and lists FilterOperator before Condition(T). The variant order is load-bearing: serde's untagged deserializer tries variants in declaration order. FilterOperator requires an 'operator' field and fails fast without it, allowing fallthrough to Condition(T). A contributor might reorder variants 'for clarity' and break deserialization silently. The comment in query.rs explains this, but it should also be noted in jmap-mail-types where EmailFilter is defined to ensure future maintainers don't try to 'fix' it.
